attributes.name: Kusarigama
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength, Melee, or Acrobatics skill + 1d6; you may additionally discard this card to add another 1d6. If not proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4.

If you fail a check to defeat a non-villain monster and are proficient with weapons, you may discard this card to ignore the result and evade the encounter; put the monster on top of its location deck.
